payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over possible beauty x, uses 2D DP (length and ending index) to count subsequences with adjacent difference >= x, then sums counts to get total beauty.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts array and DP maintains f[i][j] for subsequences length i ending at index j with min difference >= x. Two-pointer accumulation makes it O(n^2) per x. This is classic dp_2d_state.
